label: Multi-Pleated Patch
description: The multi-pleated patch chest pocket features two or more pleats — inverted or box — running vertically across its face, giving the pocket an accordion-like capacity to expand beyond its flat dimensions. This is the most utilitarian and visually busy of the chest patch pocket options, with deep roots in military and expedition clothing. In bespoke tailoring it appears on elaborate field jackets, safari-influenced designs, and highly individual commissions for clients who prioritise both character and practicality.
